facts.big: always · usually · often · sometimes · never + verbo
facts.label: Hábitos de TV
facts.sub: Use o advérbio antes do verbo: I usually watch TV. Com he/she, use -s: She always watches the news.

facts.label: Frequência
facts.sub: Advérbios dizem com que frequência: always, usually, often, sometimes, never. Diga I usually watch TV after dinner. No present simple, o advérbio vem antes do verbo.

facts.label: Ele e ela
facts.sub: Com he, she e it, o verbo ganha -s ou -es: He watches football. She always watches the news. Em perguntas, use do ou does: Do you watch TV? Does he watch TV?

“Luisa, do you watch TV every day?” says Tara. “Yes, I usually watch TV after dinner.” says Luisa. “What do you usually watch?” says Tara.
